metadata.title: Palier
metadata.description: A free, open-source tool for practising the Public Service Commission's Second Language Evaluation.

footer.nonAffiliation: Palier is an independent, open-source study tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the Public Service Commission of Canada. It contains no real test questions and its results are not official.

home.title: Practise for the Second Language Evaluation
home.tagline: Reading, written expression and oral practice for the Public Service Commission's SLE — no account, no cost, and it works offline.

about.title: What Palier is, and what it is not
about.independence: Palier is an independent study tool, built in the open. It is not the exam, and using it is not a substitute for the Public Service Commission's own preparation material.
about.noRealItems: It contains no real test questions. Every item is written or generated for practice, and no result it produces is official.

common.loadFailed: Something went wrong loading your study data. Reload the page to try again.

start.title: Let’s set up your practice
start.directionFrenchHint: Reading and written expression, level C focus
start.localNote: Your progress stays on this device. You can export it or delete it any time.
start.targetBHint: You handle routine work situations: most emails, memos and meetings on familiar topics.
start.targetCHint: You handle complex, abstract and sensitive matters: nuance, register and implication included.
start.testDateLabel: I have a test booked on (optional)
start.placementDiagnosticHint: About 15 minutes per skill. It shows which kinds of items you already get right.
start.placementSkipHint: You can take it later from today’s plan.
start.goalHint: You can change this whenever you like.

today.title: Today
today.setUpBody: Two quick questions and you’re ready.
today.readinessNote: Accuracy on practice items, not an exam result. Mock exams arrive later.
today.provenance: {count, plural, one {Based on your last answer} other {Based on your last # answers}} in {skill}.
today.firstRunBody: Take the diagnostic and this card shows your accuracy on each level of item.
today.rowDetail: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} · {minutes} min
today.doneBody: You’ve answered everything available right now. New reviews come due tomorrow.
today.reviewDue: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing due} one {# item due} other {# items due}}
today.testCountdown: {days, plural, =0 {Your test is today} one {Your test is tomorrow} other {# days to your test}}

drill.keyboardHint: Keys: 1 to 4 to choose, Enter to confirm.
drill.recordFailed: Your answer could not be saved. Try confirming again.
drill.nothingBody: You’ve seen every available item recently. Come back tomorrow for your reviews.

diagnostic.title: Diagnostic
diagnostic.intro: About {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}, sampled across every level. There is no feedback until the end, so you see where you stand rather than learn as you go.
diagnostic.insufficient: {attempted} answered. {needed, plural, one {# more is needed} other {# more are needed}} before a figure is shown.
diagnostic.resultNote: This is accuracy on practice items with its likely range, not a band. Only a full mock exam can give a band.

review.title: Review
review.summary: {count, plural, one {# item due} other {# items due}} · about {minutes} min
review.emptyBody: Come back tomorrow, or do a set anyway.

progress.title: Progress
progress.subSkillEmpty: Answer a few items and each sub-skill you practise appears here.
progress.answered: {count, plural, one {# item answered} other {# items answered}}
progress.timeAnswering: {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} spent answering
progress.honestTitle: What this does and does not tell you
progress.honestDoes: It shows how often you get items right at each level, and the range the true rate most likely sits in.
progress.honestDoesNot: It is not a band. Practice items are not a calibrated test, and this bank is still small and partly synthetic. Only a full mock exam can give a band.
progress.exportBody: Download everything as a JSON file you can import later, on this device or another.

data.title: Your data
data.intro: Everything Palier knows about your practice is stored in this browser, on this device, and nowhere else.
data.noRecovery: There is no copy anywhere else. If you delete it here, or clear this browser’s data, it is gone. Keep an export.
data.importBody: Restore from an export. Nothing already on this device is overwritten.
data.imported: Imported {attempts, plural, one {# answer} other {# answers}}, {reviews, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}} and {sessions, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}. {kept, plural, =0 {} one {# record was already here.} other {# records were already here.}}
data.importInvalid: That file could not be imported: it is not a Palier export this version can read. Nothing was changed.
data.importFailed: The file could not be read.
data.deleteBody: Remove every answer, review, session and setting from this device.
data.confirmBody: This cannot be undone. Download an export first if you might want your progress back.
data.deleted: Everything on this device has been deleted.

report.open: Report a problem with this item
report.provenance_generated: Machine-generated and checked automatically. Not yet calibrated against real answers.
report.provenance_authored: Written by hand and checked automatically. Not yet calibrated against real answers.
report.provenance_adapted: Adapted from a public source and checked automatically. Not yet calibrated against real answers.
